name: Saved
title: Daredevil #231
desc:
Ben begins to expose the Kingpin and accidentally puts his wife in danger in the process. Matt and Karen are finally re-united!

A recovered Matt Murdock is training boxing at Fogwell's to recover, while Kingpin is being questioned by his people about his vendetta against Matt. Ben Urich finally writes the story behind Kingpin and Matt's disappearance and then Kingpin sends his guys against Urich's wife. Matt helps them and runs away. The tailor who made an outfit just like Daredevil's calls Urich and wants to talk, and Matt listen to the conversation. Matt goes to the tailor shop and asks him to make the outfit and that no one is getting hurt anymore. Matt follows the new owner of the outfit and discovers Kingpin had payed him to injure Foggy.

Matt reaches the building before the new Daredevil and defeating him. At the end he also saves Karen.
